title: The Econometrics of Utility Transferability in Dyadic Network Formation Models
abstract: arXiv:2603.25641v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper studies how to estimate an individual's taste for forming a connection with another individual in a network when transfers are not allowed. We provide sufficient conditions for the consistency and asymptotic normality of the maximum likelihood estimator that does not assume transferable utility (NTU-MLE). We also provide a specification test to assess the validity of the transferable utility (TU) assumption. Applied to data on Indian villages from Banerjee et al. (2024), our test rejects the validity of the transferable utility assumption in 20-44% of villages, depending on the network measure. Using the maximum likelihood estimator that assumes transferable utility (TU-MLE) instead of the NTU-MLE when the TU assumption is rejected can change the sign and significance of the estimates.

translated_title: 二元网络形成模型中效用可转移性的计量经济学研究
translated_abstract: 本文研究了在不允许转移支付的情况下，如何估计个体在网络中与他人建立联系的偏好。我们为不假设效用可转移的最大似然估计量（NTU-MLE）的一致性和渐近正态性提供了充分条件。此外，我们还提出了一种设定检验，用于评估效用可转移（TU）假设的有效性。将该检验应用于Banerjee等人（2024）的印度村庄数据，根据网络度量的不同，我们的检验在20-44%的村庄中拒绝了效用可转移假设的有效性。在TU假设被拒绝的情况下，若使用假设效用可转移的最大似然估计量（TU-MLE）而非NTU-MLE，可能会改变估计值的符号和显著性。
tldr: 本文为不可转移效用网络形成模型建立了NTU-MLE的一致性与渐近正态性条件并提出TU假设检验，发现20-44%的印度村庄违反效用可转移假设，误用TU-MLE可能改变估计结果的符号与显著性。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes sufficient conditions for the consistency and asymptotic normality of the NTU-MLE and proposes a specification test for the transferable utility assumption, finding that the TU assumption is rejected in 20-44% of Indian villages and that using TU-MLE instead can alter the sign and significance of estimates.
